title: Normalized Transcript v0
$comment: AUDIT COMPARISON TOOL ONLY (DevSpec Section 31). It is NOT the future ALMS event contract. Raw Evidence != Normalized Interpretation: every event MUST carry raw_ref pointing back to the raw artifact, so the normalizer cannot silently delete inconvenient semantics. When native semantics do not fit the candidate vocabulary, emit a provider_extension event rather than discarding evidence.

raw_manifest.$comment: Path to the probe-response raw run manifest this transcript was derived from.

raw_ref.$comment: REQUIRED. Reference into the raw artifact that justifies this normalized event.
